name: Nary Participation Pattern
description:
The nary participation pattern. 
This pattern re-uses participation and situation patterns. It is extracted from DOLCE-UltraLite by partial clone of elements.
competency_questions: Who or what took part in a given event, and during which time period?; Which events has a particular object taken part in, and during which time period in each case?; Which objects took part in the same event during the same time period?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
